title: Designing a Stylish Dining Space: Dining Room Design Ideas for Every Area
htmlContent:
Designing a Stylish Dining Space: Dining Room Design Ideas for Every Area

The dining room is a place for gathering and socialising which should reflect your personality. Be sure to allow for a well-thought out open plan layout, comfortable seating and ample storage,  and give special attention to the lighting, materials and finishes used in the room.  In this article we will take you through a number of ideas that you can incorporate into your aesthetically pleasing and functional dining room to enable it to fit in with your everyday needs and the style and shape of your house,  with suggestions as to help you combine it with your kitchen.

Dining Room Layout

Creating the Ideal Dining Area Layout

The ground work for any effective dining room design is always the layout of the space. When it comes to the kitchen and eating space, a well-planned dining room layout is always going to make an important difference. Pay special attention to the way traffic will flow around the table and chairs and make sure to leave enough room for your guests. If you do have a small eating room, a round dining room table can be less space-consuming than a rectangular one,  and also create a more warm and intimate kind of feel. For larger eating spaces,  the ideal options could be a great rectangular table,  which can become a real focal point for the gracious room.

Incorporating Natural Light into Your Dining Room

Use natural light within your dining room.  Natural light can be used exceptionally well within a dining room,  and can turn any dining room into a bright, floating space.  Natural light can also help to make a small room look huge.  Just position your dining table near a window for natural light to flood the room.  If you want some additional privacy, use sheer curtains or blinds. If your dining room doesn‘t have many windows,  reflect the natural light using a mirror or a wooden table. We don‘t spend enough time considering the use of natural light in our dining rooms,  and we really should.

Living Room Dining Room Combo: Merging Spaces

In an increasingly popular feature of many modern homes is the incorporated living room dining room combo. As well as being a cost effective way of creating an open plan living space,  it can also make a very compact dining room appear more expansive. The key to running these two rooms as one is ensuring the extra space is used to create a separate room- without it looking artificially cut off.  Choosing a color scheme common to the two parts of the room is a good way to create a smooth transition,  and when the two areas are combined, choosing twin furniture to divide the two sections rather than a visual wall, like a low book shelf or a stylish sofa will really deceive the eye.  If your space is relatively small, a small scale dining set or a dining nook might be the best option to save space.

Choosing the Right Dining Table

Modern Dining Room Tables: Styles and Materials

Choosing a dining table is such an important part of designing any dining room and will often the the main focal point.  Eating areas are now being designed with modern materials and sleek shapes as seen in today‘s contemporary dining tables.  They give you the opportunity for something that is more modern or contemporary, such as having an elegant table with marble tops.  Or a simple, yet effective, copper table with a slick finish with concrete. Materials for the modern dining room table can be many, but choosing a warm wooden hue will make the atmosphere much cosier, whereas glass and steel builiding‘s will make your open plan dining room even more airy.

Compact Dining Options for Small Spaces

If you don‘t have much room to eat in, perhaps because your dining room is small or because you have a combined kitchen and dining area where space has to be used to its best advantage,  then space saving dining furniture is a necessity. Size can be an issue when you are choosing a small dining table and this is where ideas such as extendable dining tables come into their own in the smallest of spaces.  Round dining tables are also a popular choice because they take up less space and are easier to converse across as you eat.

Space-Saving Dining Option for compact dining areas.

Benefit

Dining nook with built-in seating

Uses corners or alcoves to give a warm and intimate feeling to the dining experience in a small-scale environment without taking up extra space on the floor.

Square Dining Tables: Maximizing Seating

A square dining table strikes a balance between intimacy and practicality this is what makes it such a popular dining table shape in many types of dining room.  Sometimes this is overstated of a round dining table, and it truly is a conversational shape,  but a square table does offer a more defined seating layout.

Dining Room Setting

Advantage of Square Table

Small Dining Room

Can be used pressed against a wall can be an space saving device and almost act like a rectangular table but with a more rounded balanced appearance.

Formal Dining Room

Provides a dramatic and balanced center in the inventive dining room offering efficient visibility and communicating with guests easily.

Along with matching dining chairs a wood dining table can give a formal and elegant feel to the dining room.

Design Ideas for Small Dining Rooms

Space-Saving Solutions for Small Dining Areas

Designing a tiny dining room has its own difficulties, however,  when you employ expert space-saving ideas,  then it is very likely to be practical and visually appealing as well.  Think about installing built-in seats or a breakfast nook along one wall to conserve space and increase your seating possibilities without using up extra space. These design ideas allow you to enjoy perfect fitting and practical dining experience with the tiniest of dining areas.

Dining Room Idea

Benefit for Compact Spaces

Round Dining Table

The absence of sharp corners makes it more navigable,  producing an open aspect.

Extendable Dining Table

Expands when extra space for more guests is needed then Retracts to a more manageable size for daily meals.

Using Colour Palettes to Enhance Small Spaces

Using colour palette to your advantage is key in perceiving the space is much greater when decorating small dining room or small dining space.  Using light colours such as white,  light grey and pastel colour range would be particularly reflected in the coloured surface in the room; it would feel airy and spacious in the night of space! Too many similar shades in monochromatic colour range would create a sleek, modern dining room look, avoiding unnecessary clutter of visual image make the small space even tighter.  Using statement colour from few bold accent colours such as dining chairs or decoration items would showcase more of your creative dining room.

Accent Walls: Adding Bold Statements in Small Dining Rooms

However, even in a small dining room,  an accent wall can be a clever interior design touch to add some boldness and visual interest to separate areas without overwhelming the space. By giving one wall a more intense or deeper tone, you can add a focal point to catch the eye and make the whole dining room feel more lively and well thought out. For a contemporary dining room,  you might want to go with a textured wallpaper or an eye-catching paint color that complements the existing color scheme. The important part is to choose a wall that will make a great background to the dining table or a console and the accent wall will add a lot to the comfort level of your intimate dining space.

Creating a Cozy Dining Room Feel

Incorporating Sofas into the Dining Room Design

For those true aspiring to create that cozy dining room atmosphere,  then it’s worth to go a step further than a classic dining chair and incorporate a sofa or sometimes a sofa bench to your dining room furnishing to achieve the much appreciated relaxed welcoming setting on which long palatable dining sessions depend.  Here a rather delicate upholstered sofa on one side of the wood dining table can upgrade your meal to that more luxurious spectrum of prolonged fine dining.  Useful in open plan living and dining environments,  it will also help to separate the different functions the sofa acting as an unassuming divider while making the best use of the available space.  Selecting a solid living room fabric with a matching color scheme is vital to the balancing of style with practicality.

Choosing Elegant Decor for a Warm Atmosphere

Having elegant decor is essential in making your room inviting and cozy and when thinking of elegant dining room ideas, simply adding furniture is rarely enough.  Achieving the elegant feel in the dining room can be achieved by paying attention to the more subtle details that will help add to the feel of a cozy and warm elegant dining room.  Using soft textures like a plush rug under the table or soft curtains to filter the light of the large window will add texture and help to soften sound in the kitchen and dining room therefore making it seem more cozy.  Choosing a stylish light fixture such as a globe of a chandelier above the table will help to add lighting to the room and make the space more inviting.  Completing this cozy feel with decor items such as picture frames of family, a table center piece or fresh seasonal flowers will add the final touches to the cozy and welcoming dining room.

Gallery Walls: Personalizing Your Dining Area

A gallery wall is a fantastic way to add a touch of personality and charm to your dining room. Interestingly, a gallery wall doesn‘t merely have to be found in your lounge room your dining space could also be made more visually appealing with an attractive gallery of photographs,  art, or mirrors. You can also use your gallery wall to showcase your personality and interests to make the most of the space, for example,  by selecting artwork and photographs that have significance in your life. When selecting items to use,  think about the color scheme for your dining space and pick complementary or soft contrasting items to enhance the overall look of your dining room.  Implemented well, a gallery wall will add structure and interest to your stylish dining room while making it warm and inviting.

Marble and Other Surfaces in Dining Room Design

The Elegance of Marble in Dining Spaces

Marble has long been associated with luxurious style and classic refinement and has recently become a great choice for almost any style of dining room design.  Whether you opt for a marble dining table,  or simply want to add a flourish with the marble accents you choose for your dining room,  the chic veining and smoothness of marble lends an instant air of elegance to the dining room. If you have the space,  incorporating marble into other features of the room, such as a built-in buffet top or a feature accent wall,  will offer an elegant look.  With some tender loving care, marble will maintain its fantastic look after many years.

Built-in Features for a Modern Dining Experience

Built-in looks are definitely a feature of the modern dining room design,  not only do they look fantastic and add to creating a minimalist look, but they are also great space savers for a big family or a house warming for everyday dining. If your contemporary rooms are a kitchen and dining room combo, a built in banquette or dining nook is one way to go to make the most of the space.  They are also attractive and cohesive when built in to match the style of the table and chairs that you choose for the room. A built in buffet or shelving unit is also something you may want to include in your modern dining room if the built in is built in to match the table and chairs, or you want a built in to surround the table.

Choosing the Right Surfaces for Durability and Style

To maintain a midcentury style and modern aesthetic, selecting the appropriate surfaces for your dining room should be done with care so as to balance durability with style.  While marble countertops are beautiful,  there are other varying material options that can set a gorgeous tone within a dining room. For those higher-traffic rooms and especially during a busy meal, a ceramic or porcelain counter or tabletop is durable, easy to clean and stain-free,  and a perfect place for a dinner party or a cozy night in. For a more rustic yet polished look, a mahogany or oak table adds a cool hue and natural material tone that offers cosiness into a dining room or a small breakfast nook.  Consider this when thinking about your ideal midcentury dining room aesthetic and feel confident that the proper mix of surfaces will keep you dining comfortably for years.
